en.hubeali: H 14656 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws

regarding the Statement of the Highazwj: “[3:103] and you were on the brink of a pit of fire, then He saved you from it, through Muhammadsaww.’’ By Allahazwj, this is how Jibraeelas came down with it upon Muhammadsaww’.
en.sarwar: 208. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, who has narrated the following:

Abu Abdullah (a.s.) regarding the Statement of the High (azwj): “[3:103] and you were on the brink of a pit of fire, then He saved you from it, through Muhammad (saww).’’ By Allah (azwj), this is how Jibraeel (as) came down with it upon Muhammad (saww)’.
